title: Zhang--Feng--Khandelwal finite-strain periodic composite, Table 5
purpose: Provide a fail-closed numerical comparison fixture for regional finite-strain J2 periodic-cell analysis without embedding external answers in solver logic. The comparison consumes caller-supplied arrays and Boolean completeness assertions; it is not a content-bound promotion decision.
physics: Plane-strain periodic composite with two stiff circular inclusions, one circular void, logarithmic finite-strain J2 matrix plasticity, elastic inclusions, and macroscopic simple shear.

source.authors: G. Zhang, N. Feng and K. Khandelwal
source.title: A computational framework for homogenization and multiscale stability analyses of nonlinear periodic materials
source.journal: International Journal for Numerical Methods in Engineering 122 (2021), 6527--6575
source.reference: Section 3.2.1, Figure 9, Table 5 and Appendix B

parameters.unit_cell: unit square, plane strain, unit reference thickness

execution.evidence: The fixture creates the published geometry with Gmsh physical regions, exact opposite-face periodic node pairing, the public affine-periodic constraint, regional finite-strain J2 materials, model.step, accepted quadrature state, and periodic-cell history. The primary diagnostic now uses the exact two-dimensional Q9/DPC1 plane-strain route and reports an explicitly reconstructed primal Hencky elastic energy beside the condensed mixed channel and its gap decomposition. The older thin-3D tetrahedral P2/DG0 route and displacement-only P1 route remain diagnostic A/B options. One exploratory 502-cell, 20-increment thin-3D diagnostic reported 1.4324 percent first-Piola vector-L2 error, while P11 and P22 failed the componentwise absolute-plus-relative contract. Its condensed ELENER was 0.002627074, but that is not the Table 5 primal-energy observable and no relative Table 5 energy error is assigned. The reported run also had a 1.054e-8 maximum Hill--Mandel relative residual and zero periodic mismatch. Neither route has a sealed, content-bound evidence archive, so these runs are diagnostic context, not promotion evidence.

observables: Homogenized first-Piola stress in the published column-major order.

Primal Hencky elastic energy per complete reference-cell measure, reconstructed from aligned accepted F, mean-Kirchhoff-stress, inverse-bulk-modulus, and condensed ELENER fields; HARDENER, cumulative PDENER, and the mixed saddle potential are excluded.
Condensed mixed elastic energy, signed primal-minus-condensed gap, signed pressure-orthogonality contribution, nonnegative pressure-constraint-defect contribution, and decomposition residual.
Exact DG0 or DPC mean-Kirchhoff-stress primary field in SimulationResult and portable checkpoint; DPC XDMF uses the separately named *_CELL recovery.
The maximum quadrature defect max_q |ln(J_q)-p_h(q)/kappa|, which is not a DG0 quantity for DPC1 and is not the assembled pressure-block residual.
Homogenized algorithmic tangent in the published component order.
Periodic equation mismatch and opposite-face pairing error.
Mesh, plane-strain formulation, cell-size, serial/MPI, and restart convergence evidence.
acceptance: Caller-supplied first-Piola stress, primal Hencky elastic energy, and effective tangent must each satisfy the declared 3 percent comparison contract; an accepted comparison is not a content-bound benchmark promotion.
The result must be converged with respect to load-increment/path, mesh, and the numerical plane-strain representation; a thin-extrusion route must include thickness convergence.
First-Piola stress must satisfy both vector-norm and componentwise absolute-plus-relative contracts so a small published component cannot be hidden by the global norm.
The 1x1, 1x2, 2x1, and 2x2 cells must preserve the published cell-size invariance.
Serial and MPI execution and checkpoint/restart must preserve the accepted response.
Missing caller assertions produce incomplete; any supplied observable outside tolerance produces failed.

The comparison result must declare evidence_authority=caller_supplied_assertions_not_content_bound and cannot authorize promotion until an external evidence archive independently binds inputs, outputs, provenance, and convergence records.
limitations: The publication uses a two-dimensional quadrilateral Q2 nine-node displacement field with a DPC1 three-mode discontinuous pressure space. AgentFEM now executes that interpolation on the exact complex geometry as a diagnostic, but it has no locking-, path-, formulation-, or mesh-convergence claim and is not promoted benchmark evidence.

The published elastic inclusions are represented in the shared regional transaction by the same J2 provider with an intentionally unreachable yield stress; they remain elastic over the declared path but are not a distinct elastic constitutive implementation.

The unarchived thin-3D diagnostic passed the first-Piola vector-L2 threshold but failed the P11 and P22 componentwise checks. Its condensed ELENER is not comparable with the Table 5 primal Hencky energy; that physical-energy gate remained incomplete. Its reported periodic and Hill--Mandel values do not replace a sealed evidence archive, so the benchmark is not promoted.

For the mixed provider, K/mu <= 1e4 is a temporary implementation ceiling for subtractive tangent construction. A plastic simple-shear direction test guards tangent accuracy at the ceiling, but the value is not a general accuracy range, a constitutive validity range, or proof against volumetric locking. Residual, max_q |ln(J_q)-p_h(q)/kappa|, energy, and mesh/formulation convergence remain separate requirements.

Exact DPC primary values remain in SimulationResult and portable checkpoints. XDMF intentionally writes an explicitly recovered DG0 *_CELL field rather than relabeling multiple DPC moments as one exact cell value.

For the mixed route, ELENER is an integrated condensed elastic-energy diagnostic per reference-cell measure; it is not the Table 5 primal-energy comparison channel. The explicit energy diagnostic reconstructs the primal channel and retains the signed gap, pressure-orthogonality, nonnegative constraint-defect, and decomposition-residual terms. HARDENER is separate recoverable hardening storage, PDENER is cumulative irrecoverable energy per reference volume, and MIXED_POTENTIAL is not physical stored energy.

The exact complex Q9/DPC1 execution remains diagnostic. Load-path, mesh and formulation convergence, a current-state homogenized consistent tangent with internal variables fixed, 1x1/1x2/2x1/2x2 replication invariance, distributed mixed execution, portable restart, and content-bound evidence remain required before this external gate can pass.
